goals.title: Repro tests for wf-1795200330594 (empty-picks verification & Stage 2 critic reprompt)
goals.description: Add src/__repro__/runNov20b.repro.test.ts reproducing (1) lifecycle verification failing on a valid PASS with picks: [] and (2) Stage 2 Risk Critic reprompt not forbidding tool calls.
goals.verificationCriteria: src/__repro__/runNov20b.repro.test.ts runs and reproduces the failures.

goals.title: Fix lifecycle.ts verification on valid NO-BET / empty picks
goals.description: In src/swarm/lifecycle.ts, when proposedLegsThisAttempt.length === 0 (valid PASS / NO-BET), tell the Verification Critic that picks: [] is valid and pass when the critic rejects solely for having no picks.

goals.title: Fix Stage 2 Risk Critic reprompt & run full verification
goals.description: In src/swarm/tools/criticAudit.ts, explicitly forbid tool calls in the Stage 2 Risk Critic reprompt and run npx tsc --noEmit + npx vitest run.
goals.verificationCriteria: runNov20b.repro.test.ts, tsc --noEmit, and full vitest run pass.
